summary: Connect Zone is a Dubai-based business-setup consultancy helping entrepreneurs and companies form businesses in the UAE - mainland, free zone and offshore - with trade licensing, visa processing, PRO services and business-center solutions.
details: Based at 804, City Tower 2, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, with over 22 years of experience. Services include mainland company formation, free zone and offshore company setup, business structuring, trade licensing, freelance visas, PRO and document-clearing services, VAT registration and related support across Dubai and the wider UAE. Contact: +971 4 331 6688, info@connectzone.ae.
blogNote: Insights articles cover UAE business setup, trade licensing, free zone comparisons, visas and compliance topics for entrepreneurs in Dubai and the wider Emirates.
